verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is a chat-based AI assistant with built-in AI agents, so users interact with it and trigger agent tasks such as web search through natural-language chat. The evidence does not show that natural-language commands can operate the product itself, such as managing workspaces, settings or documents, and it gives no examples of agent command execution. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product functions and settings, concrete agent command examples or docs, hands-on corroboration of agentic operation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
